sdk.methods
===========

.. py:module:: sdk.methods


Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   sdk.methods.get_guard
   sdk.methods.post_guard_validate


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: get_guard(*, client: httpx.AsyncClient, name: str) -> Any
   :async:


   Fetch a Guard by name from the API.

   :param client: The async HTTP client to use for the request.
   :param name: The name of the Guard to retrieve.

   :returns: The raw JSON response parsed as a Python object.

   :raises httpx.HTTPStatusError: If the server returns a 4xx or 5xx response.


.. py:function:: post_guard_validate(*, client: httpx.AsyncClient, name: str, body: dict[str, Any]) -> Any
   :async:


   Submit content to a Guard for validation.

   :param client: The async HTTP client to use for the request.
   :param name: The name of the Guard to validate against.
   :param body: The request body, including ``llmOutput`` and any additional fields.

   :returns: The raw JSON response parsed as a Python object.

   :raises httpx.HTTPStatusError: If the server returns a 4xx or 5xx response.
